inferred_claims_per_day.method: same op (claim_account), same 5-day RC regen window; anchor = measured sustainable rate of the reference factory × (headcorner max_rc / reference max_rc)

If A2 shows cost C RC/claim, exact sustainable rate = max_rc/5 / C.

bounds_refined.lower_method: same RC-budget fraction as justyy → naive ratio (165 × max_rc ratio)
bounds_refined.upper_method: headcorner all-in on claims AND claims consume only ~10% of justyy's regen budget
